address.streetAddress: 7356 SW 107th Ave, Lissette Deler Wellness, Miami, 33173

reviews.author: Tita P…
reviews.body:
At the age of 64 I decided to have my first complete facial done. Best decision ever my face looks & feels so clean & refreshed. No pain or redness afterwards. 
Will definitely return for more services.

reviews.author: Laura G…
reviews.body:
I got an eyebrow wax and tint today and I’m thrilled with how they turned out. The shape is flattering, the color looks very natural, and the whole experience was comfortable and professional. Thank you Lissette for making my brows look so good!

Hoy me hice la depilación y el tinte de cejas y estoy encantada con el resultado. La forma quedó muy favorecedora, el color se ve muy natural y toda la experiencia fue cómoda y profesional. ¡Gracias Lissette por dejar mis cejas tan lindas!
